authoring: Blender 5.2.1 source collections plus exact native Roblox decomposition

geometry.visibleGeometry: all Blender-authored car parts are lowered together; traffic pivots remain unchanged

axes.world: X east, Y up, Z north
axes.blender: X east, Y depth, Z up
axes.manifestParts: unit.parts are direct native Studio parts; unit.blenderParts are source geometry records
axes.nativeSize: Roblox BasePart.Size in world X,Y,Z order
axes.cylinderRule: Roblox Part.Shape=Cylinder uses local X as its axis; wheels use nativeSize=[depth,diameter,diameter] and nativeRotation=[0,90,0]
axes.wedgeRule: Each Blender wedge is split into a lower Part block and an upper WedgePart; WedgePart slopes along local +Z, so nativeSize=[worldZWidth,height,worldXLength] and nativeRotation=[0,-90,0] gives the authored high end at world -X

traffic.runtimePivots: Car0/Car1/Car2 pivot at world Y=15 and local traffic center Y=15
traffic.visibleParts: anchored and non-colliding; runtime owns the collider and motion
